title: Playboy Special Edition Magazine Lot of 4 + Bonus Magazine
descriptionText:
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage magazines in good overall condition for their age. Covers show some normal storage and handling wear, including light scuffs, edge/corner wear and minor creasing. Please review all photos carefully for the exact condition of each magazine. Sold as pictured.

Description:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy special-edition magazines.

Includes:

* Playboy’s Sisters
* Playboy’s Working Women — “More Than Just Pretty Faces”
* Playboy Presents: Playmates at Play — “Sweet Summer Diversion”
* Playboy’s Playmate Review — Eighth Annual, 112-page roundup

All four magazines shown are included and are being sold together as one lot.

Nice group of vintage Playboy special editions for collectors of Playboy memorabilia, glamour photography, vintage magazines and pop-culture collectibles.

These are vintage, pre-owned magazines and may have age-related shelf and handling wear. Please see the photos for the best representation of condition and exactly what you will receive.

Quantity: 4 magazines

Publisher: Playboy

Format: Magazine / Special Edition

Language: English

Genre: Men’s Interest / Photography / Collectibles

Sale: Lot of 4 + 1
